description: Read the timeline of your Editor project (or one shared with you) track by track: every clip with its index, label, start, end, length, in and out points in its file, link, speed, volume and fades; the project's media (ids and names to place), its text layers, its colour look, the motion blocks and film stocks that exist; and check, the things to look at before an export (a clip playing past the end of its file, a clip with no file or no length, clips overlapping on a track, a mix that could clip, words running past the video, black gaps, unused media), each with its second and clip. Also every timeline tab of the project (id, name, open or not, length) and the project's shape. The media list only with include_media true; readback summary gives track lengths and clip counts only. Fix every warning in check before you say the edit is done. The loudness note (mix.peak) is a worst-case guess the export limiter already holds at -1 dB: report it and leave it to the creator. Free. Call it before and after edit_editor_timeline so you know the indexes and ids.

include_media.description: Also list the project media (ids and names to place). Default false.

readback.description: How much timeline comes back. full: every track and clip. changes: only the tracks this call changed. summary: each track's clip count and end. Fields left out are empty or at their default (speed 1, volume 0 dB, no fades, enabled). Default full.

timeline.description: Which timeline tab to read, by name or id. Default: the open tab.

name: read_editor_timeline
title: Read Editor Timeline
